# orchestrate

Read and follow [the canonical `orchestrate` skill](../../../agent-orchestration/skills/orchestrate/SKILL.md) from the pinned agent-orchestration kit (if it's missing, run `git submodule update --init agent-orchestration`). Its own links resolve beside it.

This repository's rules come first: AGENTS.md, "Agent kits", and the documents it names. This repository's bounds are AGENTS.md's Orchestration facts and Working modes: attended is "work with me", unattended is "keep going unattended". An owner's hold in the conversation ("don't deploy yet") overrides the default merge and push. The session clock and guard are installed in `.github/hooks/` (generated by `scripts/agent-kits.mjs`): mark the session's role and mode with `node .github/hooks/orchestration-clock.mjs mark role …` and `mark mode …` at the start, and act on every reminder.
